description: This file defines an extension on the String class that adds a computed property 'nonEmpty'. This property trims whitespace and newlines from the string and returns the string itself if it is not empty; otherwise, it returns nil. It provides a utility to check if a string contains non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: A computed property that returns an optional String, which is non-nil only if the original string contains non-whitespace characters after trimming.
